actualDepthRangeMeters.note: MBARI gives 600-900 m for vampire squid in Monterey Bay. OceanEye places this curated encounter at 850 m, near the lower edge of the twilight zone; the range is not presented as a complete global limit.

habitat: Throughout temperate and tropical oceans in extreme deep sea conditions.
stageSummary: Despite the name, the vampire squid is neither a vampire nor a squid, but the last surviving member of an ancient group of cephalopods.
summary: "Don’t be fooled by the misleading name—this cephalopod is neither a vampire or a squid! The vampire squid is a gentle scavenger floats through the deep sea collecting drifting debris called marine snow with long feeding filaments. The unique characteristics that set them apart from other cephalopods help them survive in the ocean’s darkest depths." - Monterey Bay Aquarium

annotations.title: Not a Squid
annotations.body:
"Scientists named this animal Vampyroteuthis infernalis, which means “vampire squid from hell.” But the vampire squid is no squid at all—they’re the only living member of the family Vampyroteuthidae in the phylum Mollusca.

This misleadingly-named cephalopod has a storied history of misclassification. When this species was first discovered in 1903, they were classified as a type of cirrate octopus like the flapjack octopus due to the webbing between the arms and pair of fins on the mantle. In the 1940s and 1950s, however, scientists determined that it was neither an octopus nor squid, but part of a different group based on its unique features." - Monterey Bay Aquarium

annotations.title: Huge Eyes
annotations.body:
"One of the vampire squid’s most striking characteristics is their large eyes—the biggest eyes of any living animal in proportion to their body size. Their eyes are about one inch in diameter, while their bodies can grow up to 12 inches in total length. If a human had the same proportions, our eyes would be about 9 inches in diameter!

If you watch a video of a vampire squid in the deep sea, you’d think their eyes glow bright blue. But that’s actually a trick of the light. When the clear eyes of a vampire squid are illuminated by the lights of a remotely operated vehicle, they reflect the surrounding water and appear blue in the footage captured by scientists." - Monterey Bay Aquarium

annotations.title: Camouflaged color
annotations.body:
"Vampire squid thrive in the oxygen minimum zone, where oxygen levels are only a fraction of those near the surface. Their passive feeding strategy requires very little energy, making it ideal for life in low-oxygen environments.

Relatively few predators can hunt in the oxygen minimum zone, but the vampire squid does not take any chances. That dark, reddish-brown color keeps Vampyroteuthis camouflaged in twilight waters where red light cannot reach. When threatened, vampire squid turn their cloak of webbed arms inside out, changing their appearance to confuse predators. If danger remains, the tips of their eight arms glow with pulsing blue bioluminescence—another form of visual trickery. They do not have ink for defense like many cephalopods, but can release bioluminescent fluid to distract predators." - MBARI

zh.actualDepthRangeNote: MBARI 给出蒙特雷湾吸血鬼乌贼常见的 600-900 米深度。OceanEye 将这次相遇安排在 850 米、暮光层下缘附近；这里不把该范围表述为完整的全球分布极限。
zh.habitat: 广泛分布于全球温带与热带海域，栖息在环境极端的深海水层。
zh.stageSummary: 别被名字骗了：吸血鬼乌贼既不是吸血鬼，也不是乌贼，而是一个古老头足类支系最后的幸存者。
zh.summary: “别被这个容易误导的名字骗了——这种头足类既不吸血，也不是乌贼！吸血鬼乌贼是性情温和的腐屑食者，漂游在深海中，用细长的取食丝收集缓缓下沉的碎屑，也就是‘海洋雪’。那些使它有别于其他头足类的独特特征，帮助它在海洋最幽暗的深处生存。” - Monterey Bay Aquarium

feeding-filament.title: 并不是乌贼
feeding-filament.body:
“科学家将这种动物命名为 Vampyroteuthis infernalis，意为‘来自地狱的吸血鬼乌贼’。但吸血鬼乌贼根本不是乌贼——它是软体动物门幽灵蛸科（Vampyroteuthidae）唯一的现生成员。

这种名不副实的头足类，有一段屡遭误判的分类史。1903 年首次被发现时，科学家因为它的腕间有蹼膜、外套膜上生有一对鳍，把它归入了与烙饼章鱼相似的有翅亚目章鱼。直到 20 世纪 40 至 50 年代，科学家才根据它独有的特征确定：它既不是章鱼，也不是乌贼，而是属于另一个独立的类群。” - Monterey Bay Aquarium

large-eyes.title: 比例惊人的大眼睛
large-eyes.body:
“吸血鬼乌贼最醒目的特征之一，是一双巨大的眼睛；若按眼睛与身体的比例计算，它拥有所有现生动物中最大的眼睛。它的眼睛直径约 1 英寸（2.5 厘米），全长则可达 12 英寸（30 厘米）。如果人类也有同样的比例，我们的眼睛直径将接近 9 英寸（23 厘米）！

观看深海影像时，你或许会以为吸血鬼乌贼的眼睛正发出亮蓝色光芒；其实，那只是光线制造的错觉。透明的眼睛被遥控潜水器的灯光照亮后，会映出周围海水的蓝色，因此在科学家拍摄的影像中显得像在发光。” - Monterey Bay Aquarium

webbed-cloak.title: 藏进暮光的体色
webbed-cloak.body:
“吸血鬼乌贼生活在大洋最小含氧带，那里的含氧量只有近表层水域的一小部分。它以被动方式取食，所需能量极低，十分适合低氧环境。

能进入最小含氧带捕猎的动物并不多，但吸血鬼乌贼仍不掉以轻心。它暗红褐色的体表，在红光无法抵达的暮光水域里，几乎与周围融为一体。受到威胁时，它会把相连的腕网向外翻转，像斗篷一样罩住身体，以突变的轮廓迷惑捕食者。如果危险仍未解除，八条腕的末端还会以脉冲方式发出蓝色生物光——又一次视觉欺骗。它不像许多头足类那样用墨汁防御，却能释放发光液体，转移捕食者的注意。” - MBARI
